governance.charter_rule: if no authentic project-owned public action→outcome source with provenance and access rights, record NO_INDEPENDENT_CONSEQUENCE_SOURCE and stop scientific admission
governance.no_authority_inferred_from: historical source PRs, source-only CI, Mind-Palace records, or this advisory

synthesis.conclusion: The inspected natural-source history line establishes real partial-observation opportunities, but fixed short-history prediction has mixed/no-go results; a stronger conventional recurrent is qualified; S4C1 native showed a promising developmental signal but its trained model identity was not reproducible; third-source S4C1 transfer was negative and resource-expensive; MR34J1's added history failed while categorical current representation improved. O22-Z only proves authored-fixture decision revision shared by cheaper conventional recency. No repeatable native task/reward advantage or unfamiliar transfer is established.
synthesis.boundary: This is not a theorem that native causal memory is impossible. It closes repeated variants of the inspected fixed-history, local effect, recurrence, patch graph, and teacher-assisted methods on the cited consumed source cohorts.
synthesis.eligibility: No inspected new candidate is currently eligible for fresh original-world first-use. FSA #83 remains open and blocks admission.
